name: solidity-epoch-merkle-airdrops
title: Epoch Merkle distribution
description: Independently funded ERC20 distribution epochs with double-hashed leaves and per-index replay protection.
assumptions: Open epoch creation uses funder-owned budgets. Leaves include epoch and index and use OpenZeppelin-compatible double hashing; internal Merkle pairs are sorted. Root publishers must construct unique valid allocations. Claims stop at the deadline; only the funder can reclaim the remainder.
